title: Skill schema + mock harness + contract test
acceptance: Skill = name + NL description + typed slots + MoshOps template + preconditions + engine-mock-assertable postcondition. A harness runs one reference skill against the engine mock and asserts postconditions; the catalog is tied to the real command surface by extending commands.contract.test.ts. One reference skill passes end-to-end; contract test green.
notes: Script-independent (does NOT need O2 demo script). Likely safe bucket if it stays in ui/ + service/**.py + tests; if it needs src/ it routes to owner.

title: Reconcile the two skill catalogs (ui/src/agent/skills.ts vs service/skills/)
acceptance: A drift table establishes what the two catalogs actually share; the boundary is decided and written down; a test FAILS when they diverge, RED-proved by planted divergences and then removed.
notes: Off-backlog, found 2026-07-27 while auditing FS-B1's 'no second hand-maintained catalog' constraint. Finding: service/skills/ is NOT a second hand-maintained catalog (moshops_catalog.py parses ui/src/agent/commands.ts; library.jsonl is mined) and overlaps skills.ts on 0 skill names / 5 of 40 commands, so they are kept SEPARATE by decision. Two real defects fixed: the projection truncated 2 of 124 command descs (escape-unaware regex), and the shipped library.jsonl was validated against the catalog by nothing. Guard split across lanes on purpose: the cheap gate's py suite is path-scoped to service/|relay/, so the ui/-side guard is the vitest one. See docs/first-stranger-program/SKILL_CATALOG_BOUNDARY.md.

title: Project-file schema versioning (prereq for S1/S2)
acceptance: Version int in project/session state; forward-migration scaffold (vN reads vN-1); refuse-with-message on unknown future versions. vN opens a committed vN-1 fixture via migration; a synthetic v(N+1) file fails safely with a clear message; selftest coverage. MUST merge before S1/S2 add state fields (spec §1.6).
notes: Touches src/state → owner-merge bucket. Hard sequencing gate: T3 before S1/S2.

title: Autosave + crash recovery
acceptance: Interval snapshot + JSONL replay-from-snapshot (mosh-log.jsonl is the primitive); recovery prompt on unclean relaunch; save-on-quit prompt; relaunch-after-plugin-crash offers 'open without third-party plugins' (safe mode via block_plugin). kill -9 mid-edit → recovered state matches pre-kill snapshot+replay, deterministic ×3, in a harness gate. No audio-thread allocations/locks (RT-safety review).
notes: Touches MoshEngine → owner-merge bucket. First act: verify what autosave code already exists (spec §0 gap-verify).

title: Brain-key token proxy (Edge Function + BrainProxy retarget)
acceptance: Supabase Edge Function exposing an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint; provider key as a function secret; per-install UUID (Keychain) sent as a header; per-UUID daily budget + rate limit; hashed non-PII end-user id in provider metadata. BrainProxy retargets to the function URL; the bundled-key path is deleted. `strings` over the packaged app finds no key. (Gates need the deployed function → O4.)
notes: blockedOn O4 (deployed function + commercial key). Code is implementable now; end-to-end gate needs O4. Excluded paths (auth/secret + supabase/functions) → owner-merge. Do NOT ship a bundled key.

title: Wire the K1 packaging check + BOM enforcement
acceptance: Scripted, blocking packaging check: no RAVE/anira artifacts or weights in the bundle (spec §1.11); every BOM §1 row that ships has a NOTICE; 'Powered by Stability AI' + 'Powered by Tracktion Engine' present; enumerate the packaged service/ payload (anything shipped must have a BOM row). Funding-trigger thresholds recorded where the owner sees them at raise time.
notes: BOM doc already landed (FS-000). This wires enforcement into the deploy path → excluded (deploy scripts) → owner-merge bucket.

title: Sentry crash reporting (opt-in)
acceptance: Sentry Native SDK (crashpad backend, out-of-process handler); dSYM upload in the release script; first-run opt-in consent copy; PII scrubbing on crash payloads. An induced crash in a release build appears in Sentry, symbolicated; opt-out honored.
notes: Adds a dependency (cmake pins) + release-script wiring → excluded → owner-merge bucket. Free tier (5k events/mo) is enough.

title: Sign + notarize + staple DMG
acceptance: Developer ID signing (hardened runtime, --timestamp) over all binaries incl. the Python payload; notarytool submit --wait; staple the DMG; entitlements (disable-library-validation for VST3/AU hosting, WKWebView JIT, mic); acknowledgements surface. On a clean macOS account: mount DMG → drag → launch with zero Gatekeeper overrides; third-party plugins load; mic works; Moshi works (proxy).
notes: blockedOn O1 (Apple Developer enrollment). Prep tasks (entitlement plist, scripts) may proceed but gate needs O1. Excluded (deploy/packaging) → owner-merge.

title: Sparkle 2 auto-update scaffold
acceptance: Sparkle 2 via CMake; EdDSA keys (private in Keychain); SUPublicEDKey in Info.plist; static appcast (GitHub Pages or R2); generate_appcast in the release script. Full round-trip on a test machine: install v0.0.x → publish v0.0.y → in-app update → relaunch on v0.0.y, still signed/notarized.
notes: blockedOn O1 (needs signing/notarization to round-trip). Scaffold may proceed. Excluded (cmake/deploy) → owner-merge.

title: Session sizing spike (report only)
acceptance: 3 instances across 2 machines through the current relay. Measure: rejoin-after-network-blip (measurement #1), commit propagation for a ~50MB take, relay/Supabase limits, duplicate-delivery across reconnect. Output = a written report in docs/ with numbers + a sized S1/S2 plan. Nothing merges from S0.
notes: blockedOn owner hardware (2 machines + live relay). Report-only; owner-run.

title: R2 content-addressed take path
acceptance: On keep/commit: hash audio (reuse RenderLayer SHA-256), encode Opus proxy (96-128 kbps), upload proxy then WAV to R2 via short-lived presigned URLs (Supabase Edge Function), broadcast the reference over Realtime, peers resolve + upgrade proxy→WAV in place. Kept take audible on a 2nd peer <5s (proxy) ×3; cache hit ⇒ zero refetch; all mutations via MoshOps.
notes: blockedOn T3 (schema versioning) + S0 (sizing) + O4 (R2/Supabase). Excluded (supabase/auth) → owner-merge.

title: 4-player session
acceptance: Relay + session state for 4 peers; late-join catch-up (snapshot + JSONL replay); rejoin-after-blip without forking; bounce-on-commit v1; idempotency key (operation_id) + expected revision per command (duplicates no-op, stale rejected); strictly monotonic per-project cursor. Scripted 4-user session survives join→edits→leave→rejoin→commit-storm with zero data loss, converged, ×3 deterministic.
notes: blockedOn S1 + S0. Excluded (relay/server.py, room.py) → owner-merge.

title: First ~10 skills from the demo beats
acceptance: ~10 skills derived from the demo script's beats (O2), not a DAW taxonomy. Each passes the mock harness AND one real-engine run; failure modes produce user-legible refusals, never partial mutations (one undo txn per command holds).
notes: blockedOn O2 (demo script). Depends on FS-B1 harness.

title: Router v1 (cloud brain via the T1 proxy)
acceptance: Retrieve candidate skills → select → fill typed slots → confirm/execute. Eval set from the script's utterances + paraphrases. ≥90% top-1 skill selection on the scripted-utterance eval; 100% of executed fills are schema-valid (invalid fills caught pre-execution).
notes: blockedOn O2 (demo script) + FS-T1 (proxy). Owner-merge (brain/auth paths).

acceptance: After O5 (arena harvest hour), port ONLY owner-picked elements into ui/src/v2. Default-win rule: if nothing clearly wins, current v2 wins and ST2 shrinks to polish-only. No further Arena rounds (spec §2).
notes: blockedOn O5 (owner judges ~38 candidates). ownerMerge (taste-gated). Do NOT touch arena/ machinery (spec §0 parked).

title: 'Toy, not tool' polish pass on the v2 shell
acceptance: HARD TIMEBOX 3-4 days. Bar: the scripted demo reads as *fun* in a video frame. Owner eyeball is the gate; do not iterate past the box.
notes: blockedOn O5/ST1. ownerMerge (owner taste is the gate). Could route via the existing polish-loop instead.

title: Turn provenance in mosh-log.jsonl (the ask, not just the commands)
acceptance: An agent turn's batch_begin line in mosh-log.jsonl carries the originating utterance verbatim; a direct UI action's line carries no utterance/turn_id; a turn that produced zero commands still records the ask. Proven natively in --selftest (AGT-PROV) against the file on disk, not a mocked exec. Telemetry/crash paths still carry command NAMES only.
notes: Off-backlog, found 2026-07-28. Verify-first finding: the seam (utterance on batch_begin args, logged verbatim by MoshOps::logLine) was ALREADY merged — the briefed 'no NL anywhere' evidence is a session with zero batch_begin lines, not a missing feature. Three real holes closed instead: the native round-trip had zero coverage (every guard was a vitest against a mocked exec); `utterance ?? label` fabricated an utterance out of Moshi's own caption (poisons the FS-B2 corpus); zero-command turns — the unserved asks, the highest-value mining rows — left no trace. No new command, no log schema bump (the utterance rides per-command args; FS-T3 versions the MOSH_PROJECT tree, a different artifact). Hands-free onUnknown deliberately NOT logged (overheard speech, never addressed). See docs/first-stranger-program/lanes/fs-b2a.md.
